edhrecContext.summary: Current EDHREC context shows approximately 3.8K Mazirek decks. Leading tags are +1/+1 Counters, Sacrifice, Aristocrats, and Tokens; the average-deck page reinforces sacrifice outlets, token engines, death-trigger draw, ramp, interaction, and protection. This is context only, not ownership or legality validation.

plan.commanderPlan: Create and sacrifice expendable permanents so Mazirek turns each sacrifice into a board-wide +1/+1 counter, then convert the enlarged board into combat damage or aristocrats life loss.
plan.subthemes: Token fodder and death triggers; +1/+1 counters; sacrifice outlets and edict effects; modest recursion and land-sacrifice value.
plan.curveTempo: Run 34 actual lands (16 Forest, 15 Swamp, High Market, Myriad Landscape, and Spawning Bed) with 11 ramp cards, keeping the early curve dependable for a five-mana commander. The list favors one- and two-mana accelerants and token engines, while trimming slower ramp and standalone high-cost cards; the resulting tempo is tuned-casual rather than cEDH.
plan.interaction: Permanent removal, edicts, graveyard hate by combat/value, and flexible protection support a tuned-casual table.
plan.cardAdvantage: Arena, Tracker, Skullclamp, Haruspex, Disciple, Abomination, Rites, Dispute, Village Rites, Life’s Legacy, and Inspiring Call turn expendable bodies or counters into cards.
plan.mana: 34 actual lands: 16 Forest, 15 Swamp, High Market, Myriad Landscape, and Spawning Bed, plus 11 ramp cards (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Golgari Signet, Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar, Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, Growth Spasm, Kodama's Reach, Rampant Growth, and Sakura-Tribe Elder).
plan.closingPlan: Build wide, grow through Mazirek/Hardened Scales/Corpsejack Menace, then finish with Beastmaster Ascension, Pathbreaker Ibex, token armies, or Blood Artist/Zulaport Cutthroat.
plan.coherence: The remix removes slow, conditional, and off-plan cards, adds redundant fodder/outlets/draw, and gives the list a clearer tuned-casual curve without making a cEDH claim.

plan.commanderPlan: Attack with Vaevictis to sacrifice expendable permanents and cheat permanents from the top of the library; haste and protection make the attack trigger reliable.
plan.curveTempo: Cheap mana creatures and rocks accelerate Vaevictis; the top end is reserved for engines and finishers.
plan.interaction: Decree of Pain, Ob Nixilis, Overseer, Trial of Ambition, Poison-Tip Archer, and Vaevictis provide removal; Greaves, Boots, Rhythm, Fires, Fervor, and Whip protect tempo.

plan.closingPlan: Repeated Vaevictis triggers, death-drain, landfall armies, Etali/It That Betrays value, and combat finishers. Tuned casual, not cEDH.
plan.coherence: Cuts narrow or low-impact cards, adds explicit sacrifice payoffs, haste/top-deck support, interaction, and a complete land base while preserving the strongest public parent permanents.

children.edhrecContext: Current EDHREC aggregate context lists Minotaurs, Discard, Aggro, and Hellbent as prominent Neheb tags. Top recommendations include Kragma Warcaller, Rageblood Shaman, Ragemonger, Felhide Petrifier, Sethron, Deathbellow War Cry, Neheb the Eternal, Glint-Horn Buccaneer, and Fanatic of Mogis. The Minotaurs and self-discard pages also surface Bottomless Pit, Geths Grimoire, discard/value cards, and Rakdos interaction. EDHREC is recommendation context, not legality or power certification.

plan.commanderPlan: Neheb attacks with a low-hand Minotaur board, applying discard pressure and rewarding hellbent combat.
subthemes: Minotaur tribal lords, cost reduction, token production, and tribal draw.
Discard/hellbent engines with Waste Not, Bottomless Pit, Oppression, Pain Magnification, and Words of Waste.
Madness/graveyard value from Anger, Archfiend of Ifnir, Asylum Visitor, Faithless Looting, and Dark Deal.
Combat finishers through Kragma Warcaller, Fanatic of Mogis, Neheb, the Eternal, Mogis, and Deathbellow War Cry.
plan.curveTempo: 37 lands, a two-to-four mana creature start, efficient Rakdos rocks, and fewer clunky high-cost effects.
plan.interaction: Abrade, Bedevil, Chaos Warp, Rakdos Charm, Terminate, Vandalblast, Withering Torment, and discard engines.
plan.cardAdvantage: Asylum Visitor, Greed, Geths Grimoire, Waste Not, Dark Deal, Faithless Looting, Sign in Blood, Read the Bones, and tribal Banner/Horn.
plan.mana: 37 lands plus Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Rakdos Signet, Fellwar Stone, Mind Stone, and Hazorets Monument.
plan.closingPlan: Make Minotaurs evasive, amplify combat, convert damage into mana with Neheb the Eternal, then finish through combat and attrition.
plan.coherence: This is a singleton, 100-card Commander proposal with a clear Minotaur/discard/hellbent identity, real mana, compact interaction, and multiple draw engines; it is tuned casual, not cEDH.

edhrecContext.summary: EDHREC currently aggregates 5,687 Alesha decks. Its visible popular tags emphasize Reanimator (492), Aristocrats (267), Aggro (250), and Combo (155); the child uses the first two as its primary tuned-casual identity and explicitly avoids a cEDH claim. EDHREC top-card context includes Faithless Looting, Karmic Guide, Swords to Plowshares, Buried Alive, Viscera Seer, Welcoming Vampire, Mentor of the Meek, and Reveillark.

plan.commanderPlan: Attack with Alesha, pay {W/B}{W/B}, and recur power-2-or-less creatures tapped and attacking; stock the graveyard with looting/tutors, then convert repeated ETBs and deaths into cards, mana, removal, and damage.

subthemes.name: aristocrats and sacrifice
subthemes.role: Free sacrifice outlets turn recursive bodies into selection and life-loss.

subthemes.name: graveyard setup and recursion
subthemes.role: Put targets in the graveyard and reuse them without relying on a single combo.

subthemes.name: token/artifact value
subthemes.role: Tokens and disposable artifacts provide bodies, mana, and cards.

plan.curveTempo: The child lowers the number of slow five-to-seven-mana standalone artifacts and taplands, adds one- to three-mana setup, outlets, rocks, and removal, and keeps a few high-impact four-to-six-mana recursion/payoff cards. Alesha is the midgame pivot, not a turn-three race requirement.
plan.interaction: A mix of Swords to Plowshares, Path to Exile, Mortify, Anguished Unmaking, Generous Gift, Wear // Tear, Rakdos Charm, Terminate, Tragic Slip, Nekrataal, Fiend Hunter, Leonin Relic-Warder, and a flexible Blasphemous Act/Fell the Mighty package.
plan.cardAdvantage: Faithless Looting, Mentor of the Meek, Welcoming Vampire, Skullclamp, Night's Whisper, Outpost Siege, Daretti, Solemn Simulacrum, Village Rites, Plumb the Forbidden, and repeated ETB/death recursion.
plan.mana: 34 lands plus Sol Ring, six two-mana rocks, Ashnod's Altar, Burnished Hart, and Talisman of Indulgence; the mana base is intentionally practical rather than luxury-heavy.
plan.closingPlan: Build a disposable board, recur value creatures through Alesha/Karmic Guide/Reveillark, then finish with Blood Artist/Zulaport Cutthroat, Goblin Bombardment, Marionette Master, Cathars' Crusade combat, or a Living Death swing. No cEDH fast-combo claim is made.
plan.coherence: The parent pool mixes modular artifacts, token makers, sacrifice pieces, and reanimation without enough density or fixing. This child trims isolated modular/defensive cards, improves early mana and colored sources, and concentrates creatures that are useful both in the graveyard and when re-entering the battlefield.

children.edhrecContext: EDHREC currently shows Brago among a large aggregate commander population, with Blink the dominant tagged theme and ETB, Control, Combo, Tokens, Stax, and Artifacts as secondary signals. plan.commanderPlan: Connect Brago in combat, then blink nonlands after combat to reuse ETB effects, reset Reality Acid, generate artifact/token value, and repeatedly deploy protection or interaction. The child is hypothetical and tuned-casual, not cEDH.
plan.subthemes: Primary blink/ETB value; secondary artifact recursion and token pressure (Blade Splicer, Myr Battlesphere, Mirrorworks, Thopter Spy Network); soft control through Stonehorn Dignitary and Rishadan creatures; limited combat-finisher package.
plan.curveTempo: Prioritize one-to-three-mana setup, ramp, draw, and protection so Brago can begin generating value promptly; retain a few high-impact five-to-seven-mana ETB payoffs as blink targets rather than loading up on disconnected top-end.
plan.interaction: Counterspell and Swords to Plowshares add efficient stack and creature interaction; Grasp of Fate, Reality Acid, Reflector Mage, Tragic Arrogance, and blink effects answer permanents while preserving ETB value.
plan.cardAdvantage: Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Ephara, Ichor Wellspring, Mycosynth Wellspring, Thopter Spy Network, and blinkable utility creatures keep cards flowing.
plan.mana: A basic-heavy Azorius base with 36 Scryfall-identified land cards, Command Tower, utility lands, Sol Ring, Knight of the White Orchid, Solemn Simulacrum, and Vedalken Engineer. Color identity and Commander legality passed Scryfall checks; colored-source balance and playability remain untested.
plan.closingPlan: Win through accumulated Brago-triggered value, artifact and golem/thopter bodies, evasive commander damage, and large ETB finishers such as Myr Battlesphere and Scourge of Fleets; no cEDH speed claim is made.
plan.coherence: The changes remove isolated mill, infect, aura, morph, and wheel packages while adding efficient interaction, tutoring, multiplayer draw, and commander protection. This concentrates the parent pool on Brago combat connection plus repeatable ETB/blink value.

plan.commanderPlan: Cast Brion Stoutarm, temporarily steal opposing creatures, then sacrifice them to Brion or another outlet for player damage and lifegain. Recursive and disposable bodies become reach while Brion stabilizes life totals.
subthemes: Theft package converts Act, Crew, Harness, Mark, Mass Mutiny, Mob Rule, Traitorous Instinct, and Zealous Conscripts into sacrifice fuel.

Damage/lifegain package uses Gisela, Electropotence, Ogre Battledriver, Serra Avatar, Stalking Vengeance, Well of Lost Dreams, and Brion.
plan.curveTempo: Two- and three-mana ramp, protection, theft, and setup lead into a restrained top end of Gisela, Serra Avatar, Stalking Vengeance, Steel Hellkite, and other payoffs. This is tuned casual, not a cEDH race or deterministic combo build.
plan.interaction: Swords to Plowshares, Condemn, Banishing Light, Aura of Silence, Orim's Thunder, Return to Dust, Steel Hellkite, Ingot Chewer, and Rout answer threats; theft spells are also interaction and fuel.
plan.cardAdvantage: Skullclamp, Well of Lost Dreams, Commander's Sphere, Treasure Keeper, Mimic Vat, Feldon, Sun Titan, and repeatable theft provide cards or material. Heliod's Pilgrim and Taj-Nar Swordsmith tutor narrow package pieces.
plan.mana: The 99 includes 36 Scryfall-identified land cards plus Sol Ring, Boros Signet, Ashnod's Altar, Coldsteel Heart, Mind Stone, Worn Powerstone, Burnished Hart, Knight of the White Orchid, Pilgrim's Eye, Tithe, and Treasonous Ogre. Color identity and Commander legality passed Scryfall checks; colored-source balance and playability remain untested.
plan.closingPlan: Convert stolen high-power creatures or recursive bodies into Brion damage, amplify with Gisela or Electropotence, and finish via repeated fling effects, Stalking Vengeance, Serra Avatar, Savage Beating, or a wide Mob Rule turn.
plan.coherence: The parent already contains the Brion theft/sacrifice shell but is seven cards over target after moving Brion to the command zone. These cuts remove narrow combat, landfall, generic aggro, and slow table-dependent cards without inventing additions, concentrating the existing engine.

edhrecContext.summary: EDHREC currently shows 3,287 Licia, Sanguine Tribune decks. Its leading tags are Lifegain (579), Vampires (214), Self-Damage (116), and Voltron (62). Top-card context includes Swords to Plowshares, Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose, Sanguine Bond, Font of Agonies, Anguished Unmaking, Creeping Bloodsucker, Swiftfoot Boots, Twilight Prophet, and Vona, Butcher of Magan. The EDHREC aggregate is recommendation context, not proof of legality, ownership, or playtesting.
edhrecContext.aggregateCaveat: The source packet was saved as Vintage and lists 105 main copies plus 68 sideboard copies; those counts are preserved as source metadata, not treated as Commander validation.

plan.commanderPlan: Gain life before combat so Licia's generic cost reduction is meaningful, then use her lifelink and once-per-turn five-life payment to grow a protected first-strike threat. Drain payoffs turn the same life movement into reach.
subthemes: Lifegain enablers and repeatable life payment: Soul Warden, Suture Priest, Dega Sanctuary, Gonti's Machinations, Tavern Swindler, Ajani's Pridemate, Sunbond.
Vampire/lifelink pressure: Gifted Aetherborn, Drana's Emissary, Cliffhaven Vampire, Tithe Drinker, Vampire Nighthawk, Vona, Bloodsworn Steward.
Aristocrats and life-loss payoffs: Blood Artist, Falkenrath Noble, Zulaport Cutthroat, Vito, Sanguine Bond, Vizkopa Guildmage, Defiant Bloodlord.
Resilient finishers and alternate pressure: Elenda, Sunscorch Regent, Debt to the Deathless, Approach of the Second Sun, Chandra's Ignition.
plan.curveTempo: Lower the average curve than the 105-card source by removing narrow or redundant effects, add early lifegain bodies and two-mana rocks, and reserve expensive spells for flexible sweepers and closers. Haste is represented by Hammer of Purphoros and protection by Swiftfoot Boots/Boros Charm; Licia should not be exposed without a meaningful protection line when possible.
plan.interaction: Swords to Plowshares, Vendetta, Crackling Doom, Ayli, Vona, Anguished Unmaking, Fell the Mighty, Toxic Deluge, Fumigate, Authority of the Consuls, Kambal, and Withering Boon cover creature, permanent, and go-wide threats without pretending to be cEDH stack control.
plan.cardAdvantage: Phyrexian Arena, Greed, Well of Lost Dreams, Bloodgift Demon, Alhammarret's Archive, Palace Siege, and life-linked engines sustain the hand without claiming fast-combo consistency.
plan.mana: 37 Scryfall-identified land cards plus Sol Ring, Orzhov Signet, Mardu Banner, Commander's Sphere, Pristine Talisman, and Bontu's Monument. Color identity and Commander legality passed Scryfall checks; colored-source balance and playability remain untested.
plan.closingPlan: Convert a large life total into a lethal Licia commander-damage swing, or assemble overlapping drain from Sanguine Bond/Vito/Vizkopa Guildmage/Defiant Bloodlord with Blood Artist-family triggers. Debt to the Deathless, Chandra's Ignition, and Approach of the Second Sun are backup finishes.
plan.coherence: The parent pool was over target and mixed lifegain, generic removal, alternate wins, and unrelated high-cost effects. This child makes lifegain the tempo engine, keeps only the most on-plan parent cards, promotes sideboard cards that directly reinforce the plan, and adds only two targeted staples. It is a tuned-casual recommendation, not a cEDH claim.
